result:
`bun tools/check-register.ts` found none. It scanned 436 items, and all four counters are 0: Likelihood 3 or higher and not settled, settled with no Verified line, Moved Out for a reason other than "not shipped", and two Likelihood values.

The checker reads only the last `Status:` in each entry, so I ran a separate script (`/tmp/multi.ts`) to list the entries with several. Thirty-seven entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one. In each, the last Status is the current one, and each is settled. Where an entry carries a Verified line, I did not read it.

**Mitigated**

| Entry | Reason recorded in the last Status |
|---|---|
| RISK-401 | Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block. |
| RISK-411 | The session-start fill removes the retired text. It runs in the hook, outside the Bash sandbox. |
| RISK-374 | The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. |
| RISK-391, RISK-393 | The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the permission prompt. An earlier acceptance was withdrawn because it was the user's to give. |
| RISK-226, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353, 362 | The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. |
| RISK-227 | The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on both controls. |
| RISK-497 | Line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture (r497i 6/6 vs 0/6) and on an untouched one (r497a 4/6 vs 0/6). It holds the control r497ac at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. |
| RISK-170, 199, 223 | The shipped agent files cover them. |
| RISK-222 | `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus. |
| RISK-171 | The consent paragraph in the output style and the Artemis, Athena and Heracles agent files beat vanilla on r171b and r171d and hold level on both controls. |
| RISK-185 | The output-style paragraph that has the agent read a background command's output before a dependent reply beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds level on r185c. |
| RISK-186 | The rebuild's own Bash wrapper made every git command in an isolated worktree non-simple, so it was refused (RISK-499, issue #45). A command naming git is now left unwrapped. |
| RISK-451 | The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on r451c. |
| RISK-053 | The wall guard now folds the `~/./`, `~//` and `~/x/..` spellings and escapes `[`, which had made it fail open (#42). `wall.test.ts` covers all four. |
| RISK-067 | For git, the ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`, including the `-C dir` form. For `rm`, Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses dangerous removals on its own. |
| RISK-103 | `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a probe on 2.1.327 denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried. |
| RISK-424 | The threshold test pins the literal 70000. |
| RISK-416 | One line in the output style and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` or `-0pi` call when one change repeats across files. Perl was the first edit method in 3 of 3 runs for both the output style and Heracles. |
| RISK-132 | Mitigated for options the user refused: the handover keeps every correction, refusal and consent word for word. For an option the agent ruled out alone, it is accepted and the next session rechecks it against the code. |

**Closed**

| Entry | Reason recorded in the last Status |
|---|---|
| RISK-166 | Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, so the BUILD line is superseded. |
| RISK-169 | The cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard, and run limits and Stop checks are removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour: a job dies with the turn. |
| RISK-055 | `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls. |
| RISK-059 | The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021). |
| RISK-063 | Destructive git and the user settings file ask first. |
| RISK-064 | The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary. |
| RISK-071 | The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log are dropped with the gate (OUT-035). |
| RISK-410 | The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190). |
| RISK-463 | The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, vanilla and claudetto. |

**Moved Out**

RISK-462 is moved Out as OUT-2777. The checker accepted its reason as "not shipped".

**Accepted (the only settled status that rests on someone's judgment)**

RISK-186 had an acceptance in the middle of its status history, but the last status is "mitigated". Several entries (RISK-185, 451, 463, 497) once had an agent-written acceptance that the register reopened because accepting a risk is the user's call (issue #57). Each now ends in a measured mitigation or closure, so none depends on that acceptance.
